name: Expression
description: You are given a line « n#m », where « n » and « m » are digits, and « # » is a sign « + » or « - ». Print the value of the given expression.
input_specification: The only given line has a string in form « n#m », where « n » and « m » are digits (from 0 to 9), and « # » is a sign « + » or « - ».
output_specification: Print the value of the given expression.
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
